name: UPDC Plc
source: 9M 2026 (period ended 30 September 2026, unaudited) added from UPDC Real Estate Investment Trust statement of comprehensive income, NGX filing library; thousands of naira scaled to naira. Revenue is the printed Total revenue 3,380,496 (rental income 2,407,097, interest income 962,511, other income 10,888). Operating Expenses is the printed 780,039. EBIT left blank: the statement prints no operating profit line and carries an impairment reversal of 73,256 between revenue and expenses, so total revenue plus that reversal less operating expenses equals the printed increase in net assets attributable to unitholders 2,673,713, which is the profit line. No income tax and no finance cost are printed, so PBT equals Net Profit. EPS 1.00 naira per unit is printed. | CRON 2026-11-21: FY2025 to FY2021 replaced with the GROUP column of the audited consolidated statement of profit or loss, figures printed in thousands of naira and stored here in naira. FY2025 and FY2024 from the audited annual report and accounts 2025 (Deloitte), directors report operating results, page 20: revenue 12,908,015 / 11,786,913, cost of sales 9,286,078 / 8,388,112, gross profit 3,621,937 / 3,398,801, selling and distribution 230,305 / 550,067, administrative 2,369,600 / 1,972,420, other operating income 605,500 / 434,071, credit loss 241,513 / 163,604, share of joint venture loss 7,959 / nil, operating profit 1,378,058 / 1,146,780, net finance income 1,867,338 / 162,139, profit before tax 3,245,396 / 1,308,919, taxation 1,227,062 / 472,010, profit for the year 2,018,334 / 836,909, basic EPS 11 / 5 kobo. FY2023 to FY2021 from the GROUP FIVE-YEAR FINANCIAL SUMMARY, page 102 of the audited annual report and accounts 2024 (Deloitte): revenue 5,343,622 / 5,896,957 / 825,404, profit before tax 379,935 / 330,598 / 1,617,268 loss, taxation 158,430 / 130,066 / 142,969, profit after taxation 221,505 / 200,532 / 1,760,237 loss, total equity 8,835,423 / 8,190,598 / 7,888,143, total assets 19,664,030 / 19,428,403 / 19,594,766, basic EPS 1 / 1 / 9 kobo loss. FY2023 gross profit 1,901,320, operating profit 563,596, net finance cost 183,661 and cost of sales 3,442,302 are from the FY2024 directors report operating results. Operating Expenses is the balancing figure, gross profit less operating profit. Net Profit is profit for the year for the whole group: profit attributable to owners was 974,617 in FY2025 and 432,190 in FY2024 with non controlling interest of 1,043,718 and 404,719, and 159,658 in FY2022 with non controlling interest 40,874. The earlier copy of this file stored the attributable to owners figure as Net Profit against group profit before tax and group tax, so the tax identity failed in every year, and its Operating Expenses row did not reconcile to the printed operating profit. H1 2026 left as collected from the unaudited half year statements. The FY2022 filing prints a basic loss of 1 kobo per share against a positive profit after tax of 200,532; the EPS here is computed from the group profit. | CRON 20261128: 9M 2026 column replaced in full from the unaudited Q3 2026 financial statements because the stored column failed its own arithmetic: it carried Revenue 3,380,496 thousand, Net Profit 2,673,713 thousand and EPS 1.0, while 2,673,713 over the printed 18,559,970 thousand shares is 14.4 kobo, not the stored 1.0. The filing's financial highlights print Revenue 10,296,559, operating profit 1,107,509, net finance income 716,144, profit before tax 1,823,654, taxation 608,967 and basic earnings per share 7 kobo. Ties: 1,107,509 plus 716,144 equals 1,823,653 against the printed 1,823,654; 1,823,654 less 608,967 equals 1,214,687, which over 18,559,970 thousand shares is 6.5 kobo, rounding to the printed 7 kobo. Source: NGX doclib, UPDC Plc quarter 3 2026 financial statements, financial highlights and statement of profit or loss. https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/48197_UPDC_PLC-_QUARTER_3_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_OCTOBER_2026.pdf

reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2024: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
derivedCellsNote: Operating Expenses is gross profit less operating profit for each period. ROE, ROA and the margins are computed from the rows above with group total equity and total assets from the two audited five-year summaries. Operating margin for FY2021 is withheld because the printed negative operating profit exceeds revenue in magnitude.
nameNote: the statement carried only its ticker as the name; the name is taken from the exchange listing for UPDC
